convert_to_json_friendly: convert a python object with numpy arrays or magnum Vector3 to a JSON-friendly structure
save_as_json_gzip: save a python object as a compressed JSON gzip file to the given filepath
save_as_pickle_gzip: save a python object as a compressed pickle gzip file to the given filepath
load_json_gzip: load and deserialize a compressed JSON gzip file from the given filepath
use_StepRecorder: use the StepRecorder class to record key-value pairs per step and finish each step
